correctness.rationale: Q sigma=-alpha sigma, Q sigma²=beta-(alpha+beta)sigma² yield two- and ordered four-point correlations. Subtracting pair products gives connected velocity cumulant beta/(alpha+beta)² exp(-alpha(x+z))[alpha exp(-(alpha+beta)y)-2beta exp(-2alpha y)]. Integration over ordered gaps gives rational Laplace transform with H=t*(t exp(-alpha t))*exp(-(alpha+beta)t)*exp(-2alpha t). This strictly positive increasing kernel is log-concave by Prekopa; its analytic logarithmic derivative decreases strictly from infinity to zero (small-time t^5/120, large-time linear), proving all strict sign cases and unique crossing, not only limits. Independent 15x15 Feynman-Kac lift vs 6x6 convolution cascade tested 54 alpha/beta,v,t cases, including phi and 2 boundaries.
